utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time does the book club start?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It starts at 7 tonight.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring over my spare folding chairs if the book club needs them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: That’d be great, thanks. I think we only need a few, but I keep losing track of how many people said they’re coming.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can help tally them up before the next meeting if you want, or just keep my chairs to a few until you know for sure.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the book club’s picking a new read, and everyone’s got opinions already. I’ll fill you in if I hear the final choice.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh good, I hope it’s something easy to get through. Let me know the title once it’s settled so I can plan ahead.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I will. If I hear the title before you do, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the book club, Opal. What are you thinking for the next meeting?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I was thinking we could meet next Thursday evening and talk about the first half of the book.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds good to me. Thursday evening works, and I can help get the first-half discussion going.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the book club's meeting soon, and you'd be welcome to join us if you'd like.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. I might just listen this time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Maybe just listen and see how it goes; there’s no pressure to jump in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course, Leo. I’ve got the book club notes ready, and we can pick a time that works for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, let’s pick a time that works for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: How about Tuesday evening at 7? That should give us a good chance to have everyone there.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me which book the club is discussing? I want to make sure I have the details right.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I think it’s The Night Watch this week, but let me double-check the message so I don’t lead you wrong.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, I’ll wait for the confirmed title before I mark it down.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That sounds good to me, as long as it works around pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — we can make it work around pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I’m glad we can make it fit.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the book club was meeting soon, but I’m a bit behind on the details. Did Jules say what they’re reading?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I think they said it’s a mystery novel, but I don’t know the title yet. I’m trying to find out before the meeting.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m in, just point me to the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirming, you mean the library on Thursday at 7, right?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard much about it yet, but I’d be glad to learn more if you want to tell me.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, sure, I think it’s the one with the Tuesdays and the muffins. I keep forgetting the details, but I can tell you what I remember.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds like the right one. Tuesdays and muffins is enough for me to remember it now.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can make the book club tonight if that still works.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, see you tonight then.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good, I’ll see you tonight at book club.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the book club's meeting got moved to Thursday. Are you still planning to go?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I’m planning to go. Thursday works for me.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Nice, I might see you there then. I’ll probably head over a little early.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the book club. I’m pretty sure it’s tonight, unless I’ve mixed up the day again.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I think it’s tonight too. I’d check the time, just in case.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, that sounds right. I’ll check the time before I head over so I don’t show up on the wrong night.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the book club. I think we were supposed to meet soon, wasn’t it?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I think so. We should check the time and head over.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, let’s check the time and get going before we miss it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I can lend a hand with that book club meeting.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. I’ll bring the notes and keep the meeting on schedule.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely, I’ll bring the tools and help keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’d be glad to join the book club this week. What book are we discussing?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: We’re reading The Midnight Library this week, and I’ll send you the details for the meeting time too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I’ll plan to read The Midnight Library and watch for your meeting details.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, I’ve been meaning to ask if the book club settled on the next pick yet.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Not yet, but I heard Mira was narrowing it down. I’ll check whether she posted the choice.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, let me know what Mira picks.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course, Cleo — I’ve got the book club notes ready, and I’ll make sure everyone knows the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll bring the snacks and check if anyone still needs the book.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll let everyone know, and I’ll bring a little extra tea for the group too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the book club's meeting got moved, but I didn't catch where to. Do you know?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I think it’s the community room on Maple, but I’d check the notice first just to be sure.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Right, I’ll check the notice board before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right, the book club. What are we reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I think we’re doing the mystery one this month, but I should check the exact title with the group chat.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, just let me know when you’ve got the title. I’m in.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’d be glad to join the book club discussion, Kira. Just tell me when and where you’re meeting.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Sure, but can you confirm the time and exact place first?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, let’s meet at the library at 7:00 p.m. in the reading room.
